title: The Empty Alibi
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Felix Underhill, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
